body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by an Action from a creature you can see.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Teleport 2 units to a visible empty space. If you become an illegal target, the Action loses you.

surges.html: If the triggering effect is supernatural, suppress one Rank 0 maintained benefit until the end of the turn.
After this Reaction resolves, move one normal Condition between you and one willing ally within 3 units.
